name: USS Enterprise (CV-6)
configuration: June 1942, Battle of Midway; pre-bulge hull; reconstruction in progress

structures.name: Pilot house roof and director platform

accuracy.exterior: Dimensional reconstruction from CV-6 contract offsets, CV-5 as-built plans and CV-6 1942 photos. See open discrepancies; not certified 100% accurate.
accuracy.internals: Provisional renderer-free damage volumes, not historical watertight subdivisions.
accuracy.weapons: 8 single 5-inch/38, 4 quadruple 1.1-inch, 30 single 20 mm. Local fitting geometry, some placements and ballistic/damage values remain provisional.

propulsion.basis: Forward and aft boiler groups supply one aggregated turbine group representing four shafts. Steam routing, immersion thresholds and availability are provisional.
